title: CI: a job ran over 10 minutes
thread:
**Issue #3815 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3815: CI: a job ran over 10 minutes
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[CI run 43303300091](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43303300091) on `main` (`4d55817`, push) had jobs over the 10-minute alert (#73):

| Job | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|
| [rust (test server)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43303300091/job/131510039438) | 14m 32s | success |

Split the slow job further until every job finishes under the 8-minute target, not just under the 10-minute alert, so the fix has headroom. Most splits are a count in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` (#3072): `web (unit k/K)`, `e2e smoke (k/K)` (for e2e, also refresh the `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs`), or a `rust (test <group>)` group, whose count runs its tests in that many jobs, split by name. A count splits the run, not the compile: a group slow to compile needs its tests in more binaries (the engine's `rules_<n>` each get a job by themselves). Anything that cannot be made fast belongs in the daily `.github/workflows/super.yml`, not in CI.

Night bot: you cannot change `.github/`, and a count or a new `rules_<n>` needs no change there. When the split needs a new group or other flags in `.github/ci/rust-test.toml`, or any other change under `.github/`, make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/ci-duration.yml`._
```
